help.annoFrom: First year of decision dates; enumeration uses decision date windows (art_datrozh_*)
help.annoTo: Last year of decision dates (default current year)
help.ids: Sample filter: nsud decision ids, fetched one by one with no window call
help.maxDocs: Sample filter for the live proof
help.includePdfOnly: Decisions before about 2014 have no text in the API; the text comes from the PDF (OCR when it is a scan)
help.delaySeconds: Pause between requests to the source, at least 0.3 s
help.baseUrl: Only change for a replay server (host.docker.internal)
help.refreshToken: Change this value to fetch all months again
help.tokenBudget: Maximum Jina tokens one Run may spend on embeddings (default 20000)
help.dryRun: Plan the embeddings without calling Jina
